_comment: Every product video, in display order within each product. Docs pages embed one with <VideoEmbed id="..." />; /videos lists them all. kind: explainer (illustrated concept) or walkthrough (recorded in the console). products: first entry is where it is grouped on /videos. docs: pages that cover the feature (the first one embeds it). poster: 1280x720 under static/img/. questions: what an admin would ask that this video answers; Quilr Assist matches on them through /api/v1/index.json.

videos.title: MCP Gateway: administrator overview
videos.description: Registering servers, governing which tools agents can call, reading the audit trail, and handing the gateway to your users.
questions: How do I set up the MCP Gateway as an admin?
How do I register an MCP server?
How do I control which tools agents can call?
Where do I see the audit trail of MCP tool calls?

videos.title: MCP Gateway: user dashboard
videos.description: What a user does with this endpoint: copy it, add it to Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor, and check which tools they are allowed to call.
questions: How do my users connect to the MCP Gateway?
How do I add the OneMCP endpoint to Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor?
How can a user see which tools they are allowed to call?

videos.title: Web security for AI agents
videos.description: How the MCP Gateway applies your web security policy to the pages an agent opens through QuilrAI Web Search.
questions: How do I stop agents from opening risky web pages?
Does my web security policy apply to AI agents?
How does QuilrAI Web Search protect agents?

videos.title: Automatic input aliases
videos.description: How the MCP Gateway spots recurring input mismatches, such as num_results sent where a tool expects limit, and suggests an alias that fixes the call.
questions: Why do tool calls fail with the wrong parameter name?
What are input aliases in the MCP Gateway?
How do I fix agents sending the wrong argument names to a tool?

videos.title: Local MCP: administrator setup
videos.description: Importing a local package, reviewing its source and tool schemas, approving the version, then enabling tools and access.
questions: How do I add a local MCP server?
How do I import and approve a local MCP package?
How do I review a local package's tools before enabling them?

videos.title: Local MCP: connect your computer
videos.description: Running the connection command, approving your computer in the browser, restarting your client, and calling a local tool.
questions: How do I connect my computer to Local MCP?

videos.title: Token saving on the AI gateways
videos.description: How the LLM Gateway and MCP Gateway rewrite JSON, HTML, Markdown and verbose text into fewer tokens before it reaches the model.

What does token saving do?
